verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents paying vendors, employees and contractors across 150+ countries in 40+ currencies with no transfer or wire fees, plus no setup or recurring fees. Its stablecoin rails advertise mid-market rates for USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, MXN, BRL and COP. Fee transparency is asserted mainly as an absence of fees, and other pages say only "competitive" FX rates, so the actual FX markup is unclear. missing for 10: a published fee/FX markup schedule or pre-payment fee quote, reconciliation of the 'competitive' vs 'mid-market' FX claims, independent or hands-on corroboration.
